name: Tony
role: Professional French to English translator
bio: Tony has been working as a full-time French-English translator for 10 years. He actually got into this profession when he moved to the French countryside. He specialises in various fields, ranging from the technical to the commercial sector, particularly specialising in the property market and tourism industry.

name: Nancy
role: French to English translator specialising in aeronautics
bio: Nancy brings her experience and attention to detail to BeTranslated’s clients by offering translations between French and English, as well as proofreading, editing, and writing services. She is also the representative of BeTranslated in the United States.

name: Lola
role: English to French copywriter and translator
bio: A graduate in translation from the University of Liège in Belgium, Lola translates from Spanish into French, as well as from English into French, in a wide range of fields. Her skills are highly appreciated by clients seeking a high editorial level in the tourism and travel sector. She is also a true master in the art of SEO writing, an essential skill online.

name: Kerry
role: French to English translator in the IT field
bio: Kerry translates exclusively from French into English. Due to his experience and expertise, he specialises in many fields, including computer science, security, software, and hardware, but also economics, human rights, and other related fields.

name: Frédéric
role: English to French IT translator
bio: Originally from the south of France, Frédéric has dual French and Argentine citizenship. After studying industrial engineering, he worked for 10 years in various countries as a systems engineer, combining his professional qualifications with his taste for travel. Frédéric translates between English and Spanish and specialises in the fields technology, computers and tourism.

name: Paul
role: Technical and scientific translator
bio: Paul specialises in technical and scientific translation. Curious by nature, his extensive area of knowledge has brought him many long-term clients. Perfect bilingual in English and French, he also speaks Spanish and Dutch. Organised and rigorous, Paul has good general knowledge, and is specialised in several fields, notably information technology.

name: Arnaud
role: English to French IT translator
bio: Arnaud holds a master’s degree in linguistics, translation studies, literature, and Anglo-Saxon civilisation from the University of Nantes, as well as a degree in French as a Foreign Language from the University of Grenoble. He translates from English into French for the following areas: tourism, new technologies, lifestyle, geopolitics, and literature.

name: Rafael
role: Experienced financial translator
bio: Rafael has been a translator and proofreader for more than 30 years, as well as a diplomat for 19 years. He has studied, worked, and lived in the US, two French-speaking countries (Sorbonne University), and three Spanish-speaking countries. Having been Assistant Director of Translation at the Mexican National Banking Commission for three years, he further specialised in financial translation.

name: Miguel
role: English and French to Spanish marketing translator
bio: Miguel has been working with BeTranslated for many years. He translates from English and French into Spanish. A frequent traveller, he has lived and studied in the States, the Dominican Republic, the Netherlands, and Spain. Miguel specialises in marketing translations, as well as literary and editorial texts. His talents are highly regarded by BeTranslated’s most attentive customers.

name: Juan Carlos
role: English and French to Spanish technical translator
bio: Juan Carlos is an independent professional translator based in Bern, Switzerland. Over the course of his long career, he has studied, worked, and lived in France, Spain, and Great Britain. He graduated with a degree in modern languages and translation from the University of Northumbria. He also holds a British Translation diploma (HND) in mechanical engineering from the University of Sunderland. He translates from English and French into Spanish, and from French and Spanish into British English.

name: Alicia
role: English to Spanish literary translator
bio: Alicia is a highly skilled linguist, and she translates from English into French and Spanish, and from French into Spanish, and back again. She also interprets between French and Spanish. Her preferred fields are business, politics, literature, history, music, human rights, architecture, anthropology, ethnology, gastronomy, oenology, to name just a few.

name: Andy
role: French to English business translator
bio: Andy has been a freelance French to English translator since 2005 and also works as a language teacher. In addition to French, he also skilfully translates from Spanish and Catalan into English for a large number of international clients.

name: Heike
role: German translator and editor
bio: Heike studied Literary Translation at the Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf. She has worked as a German translator and editor for over 15 years and is a member of BDÜ (German association of interpreters and translators). She excels in French and English, and is an expert in translation applications, as well as her fields of marketing, media, and business. Since 2010, Heike has taught French to German translation to possible future colleagues at the University of Düsseldorf.

name: Monika
role: French and English to German translator
bio: Monika, a freelance translator since 2011, working from French and English into German, has lived in France since 1998. She gained her translation diploma from the CCI Dortmund in 1997, and mainly works in website translation. She has experience in translating websites for a wide spectrum of industries, from finance, tourism, and food, to the footwear and automotive businesses. She prides herself on producing accurate translations that never miss a deadline.

role: English and French to German IT translator

He currently lives and works in his native Germany, where he translates from both English and French into German. Pascal specialises in translation for the IT sector, but also frequently translates websites, texts related to travel and tourism, and technical documents.
